# Grading fixtures (builder-made)

`submissions/`: v3 submissions for the grading tests. `correct.json` is a copy of the reference submission; `uncited.json` is the reference with every citation (and therefore every derivation) removed; `incorrect.json` deliberately contains wrong landmark values, rounded prose times, a wrong initiator, an automatic GT1B trip and asserted Little Barford root causes; `uncertain.json` is explicitly inconclusive; `incomplete.json` covers the frequency dimension only; `invalid_*.json` must be rejected by `validate_submission`.

`decisions/`: grading-decisions files used to test the merge of human decisions. They are BUILDER FIXTURES (`builder_fixture: true`), not domain reviews, and are bound to the sha256 of their fixture submission, to key version 0.3.1 and the key's content sha256, and to the bundle sha256. Regenerate everything with `uv run --frozen python tests/fixtures/build_fixtures.py` after changing the reference submission or the answer key.

`live/`: real live-run submissions (not builder-made, not regenerated by this script), used by `tests/test_grading_live_runs.py`; see `live/README.md`.

`sr_live/`: the six real system-response runs of the two increment-A live panels (episode files, run summaries and the 80k judge outputs; not builder-made), used by `tests/test_sr_grading_live_runs.py`; see `sr_live/README.md`.

`fi_live/`: the two real full-investigation runs (Opus 5.5 pilot and first panel run; episode files, run summaries and judge outputs; not builder-made), used by `tests/test_fi_grading_live_runs.py`, `tests/test_fi_grading_pilot_run.py` and `tests/test_judge_scope_errors.py`; see `fi_live/README.md`.
